Nicole and Colton | Digital Creatives

Hey!

We are Nicole and Colton, Canadian content creators who represent the world of travel, adventure, lifestyle, and date nights! We create high-quality, engaging content for various properties, experiences and brands around the world.

When we aren't creating content for brands, we are creating travel guides, tips and itineraries for our amazing community. 

Our only hope is that we can inspire you to chase your dreams, travel the world and create endless memories!

Travel, Adventure, Live

Services

Content Creation

We create high quality content that can be used across multiple platforms. Whether you are looking for UGC for your brands Instagram & TikTok, are in need of content for ad running and campaign promotion, or you are looking to improve your websites presentation, we do it all. Having content creation for your brand is important because it adds personality and relatability to your platforms by featuring real people that an audience can relate to! Our content creation services included: videography, photography, drone footage, modelling and brand identity/strategy. We keep up to date with trends such as ASMR, voiceovers, shorts and more while crafting your UGC. Check out our portfolio for some of our previous work!

Influencer Marketing

Influencer marketing is for those looking to reach new audiences through stories and posts on our platform. Gone are the days of TV commercials and radio ads (thank goodness because that was really expensive and how many people listening are actually your target audience?). Not only can we reach large audiences through social media, but you can now strategically reach the RIGHT audience. We have spent 2 years building an incredible community of people whose interests - like ours - are travel, adventure, and romance. Having worked with over 30 brands, we know that relatable, meaningful and authentic content is key. And good news! Being experts in both content creation and influencer marketing, we offer discounted combo packages. Check out our portfolio for some of our previous work!

Testimonials

We had the distinct pleasure of collaborating with Nicole and Colton, and it was nothing short of extraordinary. From the outset, their communication was top-notch, making the entire process smooth and enjoyable. What truly set them apart was the remarkable content they produced during their stay.

It's rare to find influencers who not only meet but exceed expectations, and this dynamic duo certainly did just that.

It's safe to say that working with them was not just a transaction but an enriching experience for our team. We wholeheartedly recommend these influencers to anyone seeking a partnership marked by exceptional communication, creativity, and an overall outstanding experience.


★★★★★

Rachel Spice, Owner, @porterspeak

It was a great pleasure working with Nicole and Colton. We wanted to emphasize the romantic and relaxing atmosphere of our establishment and they perfectly represented the spirit of our hotel through their work and even exceeded our expectations thanks to their high-quality content! You can see their great work on our website and socials. 

We will surely reconduct this collaboration which was a real success! The Wakefield Mill Hotel & Spa highly recommends them.


★★★★★

Anaís Roca, Communications & Marketing, @wakefieldmill

Nicole and Colton were wonderful to work with and really captured the essence of a Cabinscape stay.

The shared posts and stories had great engagement and they were flexible when we ran into some tech issues with our Instagram page.

We would highly recommend partnering with them for future projects. Thanks for all your hard work :)
